verdict: Leads are thin this period; six overdue milestones are holding back scale-up.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 8 leads at a cost of $223.26 per lead across $1,786 in total ad spend — volume is critically low, though the lead rate has been flat rather than falling over the past week. The paid campaigns are structurally throttled, not failing: budget scale-up is gated on six project milestones that are overdue, including confirming an intake owner and enabling the LSA heating toggle. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity dropped to zero for the past eight days after averaging roughly five actions per day prior — we are investigating that visibility gap now. The immediate focus is closing the overdue milestones so the campaigns can be released to run at full capacity heading into the fall heating season.
